Trace, implement and test: leetcode52 n queens II dfs with bit operation

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<vector>
#include<unordered_set>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
    int count;
    int N;
public:
    int totalNQueens(int n)
    {
        count = 0;
        N = n;
        dfs(0, 0, 0, 0);
        return count;
    }
    /* row: rowSet
     * set1: / 对角线(撇): x与y的和相等
     * set2: \ 对角线(捺): x与y的差相等 */
    void dfs(int dep, int row, int set1, int set2)
    {
        if (dep == N)
        {
            count++;
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) /* i代表列索引colIndex */
        {
            int j = 1 << i; /* 二进制100...0 (共i个0) */
            if ((j & row) || (j & set1) || (j & set2))  /* j & row: 水平方向上一个位置上重复放第2个皇后Q, (j & set1): / 斜对角线(撇)上, (j & set2): \ 斜对角线(捺)上  */
                continue;
            dfs(dep + 1, (j | row), (j | set1) << 1, (j | set2) >> 1);
        }
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    int n = 8;
    auto res = sol.totalNQueens(n);  // n = 8 时有92组解
    cout << res << "\n";  

    return 0;
}
